thread:
Asha: Need a quick alignment: launch posts + webinar landing readiness. Can we lock URLs and finalize redirect manifest today so SEO can run final checks?
Ben: Locking by EOD is fine. I'll export the sitemap + proposed redirect pairs and push to the shared sheet.
Nina: Also running two headline variants for the signup form: 'Predictable latency at scale' vs 'Lower inference cost per request' 1. Will share initial CTRs.
Carlos: For redirects, prefer 301 for content consolidations, 302 for temporary promo traffic. Keep UTM passthrough. Example rule in our format: `from:/old-launch to:/webinar-launch status:301 preserve_utms:true`
Asha: Good. On schema: we should add Webinar structured data + FAQPage, and ensure speakable property is omitted. Minimal WebinarEvent props: name, startDate, endDate (if known), url, organizer.name. Who can own markup?
Nina: I'll own FAQ markup and sample Q/As. Carlos can add the WebinarEvent JSON-LD to the landing template. We'll lint with the rich results tester after staging.
Carlos: I'll drop the JSON-LD snippet into the template branch and add a feature flag. Post-deploy we should inspect server-rendered HTML for rel=canonical and hreflang sanity.
Ben: Internal linking plan: 2 blog posts (how we benchmarked latency), 1 integration doc, and update product nav CTA. Anchors proposed:
- /blog/latency-benchmark -> webinar landing
- /blog/cost-optimization -> webinar landing
- /docs/rollout-guide -> webinar landing
Asha: For benchmark narrative, pick a primary metric for hero test. Enterprise SEs value latency SLAs; growth prefers percent cost savings. My call: run both as A/B headline tests and use cohort tagging to segment leads.
Nina: I'll add keyword buckets by intent (awareness, consideration, purchase) into the shared keyword sheet and map to H1/H2/meta descriptions.
Ben: Small SEO gotcha: make sure canonical header matches final redirect target and canonical link element. Otherwise Google might index both.
Carlos: Noted. Also ensure the redirect manifest includes preservation of landing query strings that map to campaign attribution. We'll add a transform rule for known UTM params.
deploy-bot: Heads up: staging deploy scheduled 1749991600 UTC for webinar template. Smoke tests will run automatically.
Asha: Thanks 1 can we reconvene Mon 10:00 PT for final sign-off on redirects, schema, and headline variant selection? If staging passes, we'll flip feature flag for live on Wed. :rocket:
